headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2021, Adam Cole kicked off their AEW journey against Frankie Kazarian, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88.
2023 brought us this moment: Kris Statlander vs. Jade Cargill put the AEW TBS Title on the line, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a strong outing. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Back on this day in 2023, Christopher Daniels was back in action after 7 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2021, when it was Dante & Sydal's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.55.
Turning the clock back to 2021: it marked the first-ever meeting between Darby Allin and Shawn Spears on Dynamite, rated 6.22.
Back on this day in 2021, Kingston & Moxley vs. 2.O met for the very first time, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 4.70.
